goldboughAvatar.label: Offer a card (lose a random card, take 6 damage)
goldboughAvatar.resultText: The card crumbles to gold leaf in its palm. Its other hand closes around yours — the blessing is not gentle.

goldboughAvatar.label: Pray (heal 20% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
goldboughAvatar.resultText: Warmth knits your wounds shut. Something else follows you out of the clearing.

goldboughAvatar.label: Leave
goldboughAvatar.resultText: The hand stays open behind you for a long time.

abandonedCart.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders; the owners may object)
abandonedCart.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

abandonedCart.label: Leave
abandonedCart.resultText: Not every gift is free. You keep walking.

weepingPilgrim.label: Give 50 cinders (gain a random relic)
weepingPilgrim.resultText: She presses the bundle into your hands and walks into the rain without counting.

weepingPilgrim.label: Refuse
weepingPilgrim.resultText: She nods, as if she expected nothing else.

bloodstainedAltar.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
bloodstainedAltar.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

bloodstainedAltar.label: Leave
bloodstainedAltar.resultText: The altar does not care. It has waited longer than you.

wanderingPhysician.label: The procedure (remove a random card, take 4 damage)
wanderingPhysician.resultText: He holds something up to the light, nods, and does not let you see it.

wanderingPhysician.label: The patch (heal 15% max HP)
wanderingPhysician.resultText: Competent, quick, and strangely cold. He refuses payment.

wanderingPhysician.label: Leave
wanderingPhysician.resultText: "Suit yourself. The spire will finish what I would have started."

goldenMoth.label: Gather the falling cinders (gain 40 cinders)
goldenMoth.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

goldenMoth.label: Sit with it a while (heal 10% max HP)
goldenMoth.resultText: You keep the vigil. When you rise, some of its lightness has passed to you.

goldenMoth.label: Leave
goldenMoth.resultText: Some deaths are not yours to attend.

feralShrine.label: Take the offering (gain a random relic — its keeper objects)
feralShrine.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

feralShrine.label: Leave
feralShrine.resultText: Wild ember keeps its own accounts. You leave the ledger closed.

ancientRuneStone.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
ancientRuneStone.resultText: The script rearranges something behind your eyes. You are sharper, and less.

ancientRuneStone.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
ancientRuneStone.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

ancientRuneStone.label: Leave
ancientRuneStone.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

graveOfTheNameless.label: Dig for cinders (gain 90 cinders; the keeper may wake)
graveOfTheNameless.resultText: The cinders come loose in cold handfuls. Somewhere under the swords, something shifts its weight.

graveOfTheNameless.label: Pay respects (heal 15% max HP)
graveOfTheNameless.resultText: You right a fallen blade and stand a while. When you leave, you are lighter than you came.

graveOfTheNameless.label: Leave
graveOfTheNameless.resultText: You leave the nameless to their naming.

sleepingSmith.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
sleepingSmith.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

sleepingSmith.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
sleepingSmith.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

sleepingSmith.label: Leave
sleepingSmith.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

wyrmTrial.label: Enter the ring (fight the soldier for 60 cinders)
wyrmTrial.resultText: You step across the stone line. The soldier finally moves.

wyrmTrial.label: Circle it instead (lose 5% max HP crossing the rubble, gain 20 cinders)
wyrmTrial.resultText: The rubble takes its toll, but the ring — and whatever waits in it — stays quiet.

wyrmTrial.label: Leave
wyrmTrial.resultText: Some rings are drawn for a reason. You leave this one closed.

discardedReliquary.label: Take it with you (gain a Guilt curse; the pack has 45 cinders)
discardedReliquary.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

discardedReliquary.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders; leave the card)
discardedReliquary.resultText: The provisions catch fast. The face-down card curls to ash before you can read it.

discardedReliquary.label: Leave
discardedReliquary.resultText: You step around the pack and do not look back.

omensAltar.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic; take a Guilt curse)
omensAltar.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

omensAltar.label: Shatter the altar (fight what wakes, gain 70 cinders)
omensAltar.resultText: The stone face cracks down the middle. What answers the noise is not stone at all.

omensAltar.label: Leave
omensAltar.resultText: The many eyes stay open behind you, patient as ever.

rotPriestOffer.label: Accept the blessing (gain a random relic; lose 10% max HP)
rotPriestOffer.resultText: His hand closes over yours. The reliquary is warm, and the warmth does not stop where your skin does.

rotPriestOffer.label: Rob him (gain 50 cinders; take a Guilt curse)
rotPriestOffer.resultText: He does not resist. He only smiles wider, as if you have taken exactly what he meant you to.

rotPriestOffer.label: Leave
rotPriestOffer.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you. "It will keep your seat."

handspiderNest.label: Snatch the strongbox (gain 80 cinders; they may wake)
handspiderNest.resultText: The box comes free with a wet scrape. All around you, fingers go still — then flex.

handspiderNest.label: Back away slowly
handspiderNest.resultText: You retrace your steps one careful footfall at a time. The nest never stirs.

fadedGrace.label: Warm yourself (heal 18% max HP)
fadedGrace.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you. When it fades, the ground is only ground.

fadedGrace.label: Temper a blade (upgrade a random card, lose 6% max HP)
fadedGrace.resultText: You hold a card to the dying ember until it takes the edge. It costs you something to keep the flame that long.

fadedGrace.label: Leave
fadedGrace.resultText: You let the ember fade unspent. Some kindnesses are not yours to take.

merchantsGhost.label: Pay in kind (give 60 cinders, gain a random relic)
merchantsGhost.resultText: The cinders vanish from your hand into a ledger that isn't there. The relic is very solid, and very cold.

merchantsGhost.label: Take it and run (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
merchantsGhost.resultText: It does not chase you. It only watches, and writes something down, and the writing follows you out.

merchantsGhost.label: Leave
merchantsGhost.resultText: "Come again," it says, to no one, already forgetting you.

cinderbearDen.label: Go for the hoard (gain 100 cinders; it will almost certainly wake)
cinderbearDen.resultText: Your hands fill with cold light. Behind you, the breathing stops.

cinderbearDen.label: Skim the edges (squeeze past the rubble, lose 5% max HP, gain 25 cinders)
cinderbearDen.resultText: You take only what is within reach and pay for it in scraped ribs. The den keeps its heart.

cinderbearDen.label: Leave
cinderbearDen.resultText: Some fortunes are guarded by teeth. You leave this one to its keeper.

stakeOfTheMartyr.label: Give what it asks (remove a random card, lose 8% max HP, gain a random relic)
stakeOfTheMartyr.resultText: The stake drinks a card and a breath of your strength, and hands back something older than either.

stakeOfTheMartyr.label: Leave
stakeOfTheMartyr.resultText: You step around the thorn. It hums after you, patient, certain you'll be back.

twoFingersRiddle.label: Sharpen (upgrade 2 random cards, take 5 damage)
twoFingersRiddle.resultText: The rhythm settles behind your eyes. Two of your cards come back keener; your hands ache with the knowing.

twoFingersRiddle.label: Mend (heal 22% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
twoFingersRiddle.resultText: Warmth floods you, generous and total. Something reads back through the water, and does not look away.

twoFingersRiddle.label: Leave
twoFingersRiddle.resultText: The fingers tap on. You leave the riddle unanswered, which is its own kind of answer.

namelessKeeper.label: Return what you took (lose 90 cinders; the keeper stands down)
namelessKeeper.resultText: The cinders go back into the lantern one by one. The keeper turns without a word and walks the way you came.

namelessKeeper.label: Face the keeper (fight; keep what you took)
namelessKeeper.resultText: The lantern goes out. Things that were following the keeper are not so patient.

namelessKeeper.label: Accept the keeper's thanks (gain the Gravetender's Bell)
namelessKeeper.resultText: A small bell, iron and cold, pressed into your palm. "One toll for each name," the keeper says. "You will know when."

namelessKeeper.label: Leave
namelessKeeper.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

namelessRest.label: Keep the vigil (upgrade 2 random cards)
namelessRest.resultText: You stand until the cinder-light gutters. The bell in your pack rings once, though nothing moved it.

namelessRest.label: Rest among the stones (heal 30% max HP)
namelessRest.resultText: What you returned bought you this much: a night among the nameless, and no one waking you.

namelessRest.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders, gain a Guilt curse)
namelessRest.resultText: Second time is easier. The names on the stone do not object. That is the part that follows you.

namelessRest.label: Leave
namelessRest.resultText: You leave the cairn as you found it, which is more than the first one got.
